content.text: Any tips on saving gas fees on Sui?

Absolutely! Batch your small transfers if you can. Also, keep an eye on transaction concurrency—Sui’s parallel execution helps maintain low fees. And always check if a big network surge is happening before you hit ‘confirm.’
Should I wait for a cheaper time to transact?
On Sui, you rarely need to wait—gas fees stay pretty stable. But if there’s a major NFT drop or DeFi event, might want to time it smartly. Just a heads-up, I’m not your financial advisor!
